information_cutoff: previous calendar day end of day
economic_vintages: verified ALFRED snapshot for each origin

media_models.Economic plus media: not estimable: fewer than 24 historical monthly news observations meeting >=10 headlines per month
media_models.Economic plus media plus controls: not estimable for the same reason

uncertainty: rolling empirical intervals do not assume independent errors; nominal 95% coverage is not guaranteed under regime shifts; block-bootstrap comparisons use length 6 and 2000 replicates
training_labels: latest available sentiment values in the origin vintage
scoring_labels: latest final values as of cutoff, except October preliminary reported separately
interval_calibration: prior forecasts scored against outcomes actually available in the current origin vintage; trailing 60 errors, minimum 24
political_controls: not included as predictors: party-average sentiment is a survey outcome, not independent exposure or an exogenous control
